response.interpretation_notes: Single main axes only. Four monotone decay curves match the legend entries slow, medium, fast, and fastest. All curves share the same left-edge starting point; the right-edge markers were kept slightly inside the frame. QA flagged only mild fast/fastest tail crowding near x=963-1104 px, but both identities remain visually distinct and below the truncation threshold.
unresolved_ambiguities: The common left-edge start marker and the clipped right-edge markers were centered conservatively inside the frame rather than on the border line.

The fast and fastest tails run close together near the lower-right corner, especially from about x=963 px to x=1104 px, but their ambiguous fraction stayed below the threshold that would force truncation.

advisories.note: For marker-bearing curves, strong near-border fractions can indicate marker-rim or frame-lock tracing even when color overlap is high. Hollow-marker centerline traces use relaxed stroke-overlap thresholds only when marker-center alignment is also good.

panel_acceptance.pass: all curves pass and no pairwise review flags
panel_acceptance.warn: no curve fails, but at least one curve warns or at least one pair is overlap-flagged
panel_acceptance.fail: at least one curve fails stroke agreement or extent coverage
